## Data Flow

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
id_cam@{shape: procs, label: "Cameras"} --> id_summit_proc@{shape: procs, label: "Transfer Adapter"}
id_summit_proc --> id_summit_nifi[Station NiFi]
id_summit_nifi --> id_dms_nifi[DMS NiFi]
id_summit_nifi --> id_ocs_nifi[OCS NiFi]
id_telem@{shape: procs, label: "Telemetry Sources"} --> id_otel_collect[OTelCollector]
id_otel_collect --> id_otel_batch[Batch/Zip Plugin]
id_otel_collect --> id_local_observability_store[Local Observability Store]
id_otel_batch --> id_summit_nifi
id_dms_nifi --> id_dms_proc[DMS Data Processing]
id_dms_proc --> id_swpc[SWPC]
id_dms_proc --> id_nso_dc[NSO DC]
id_ocs_nifi --> N[Central Observability Store]

```
